doc: URL-state routing semantics (LCP-088..112, extending LCP-005): typed view parameters, defaults and the canonical form, definitions validated as values, legacy entries, refinements, return targets through sign-in, location modes and share links, and the route inventory. conformance/routing/README.md states the rules; routing.vectors.json holds the LCP-005 vectors, which still hold. Every conforming library runs both files.

resolve.name: views: defaults are reported
views: a set is sorted and the rest typed
views: a set drops repeated members
views: a set member outside its values is invalid
views: an empty set member is invalid
views: an enum is case-sensitive
views: a bool is true or false
views: a default given explicitly resolves the same
views: a repeated key is ambiguous
views: parent defaults apply to a child
views: a month path parameter
views: month 13 is invalid
views: a leap day in a leap year
views: no leap day in 2026
views: a date needs two-digit months
views: an encoded comma stays inside a member
views: a free set needs non-empty members
views: a date path parameter
views: non-ASCII digits are not a date
views: an enum path parameter
views: an enum path parameter outside its values
views: a legacy route redirects
views: a legacy month route redirects
views: a current route wins over the wildcard
views: not permitted
views: 8,193 characters are refused before decoding
views: 8,192 characters are decoded

build.name: views: declaration order, a sorted set
views: an empty set is omitted
views: a set member outside its values
views: a non-default enum is kept
views: a default enum is omitted
views: dates, months and an encoded comma
views: text is not a month
views: a return target is one encoded value

sessions.name: refinements replace, so Back steps between places
an explicit default is replaced by the canonical form
a deep link survives sign-in, and Back does not return to it

definitionCases.name: a parameter declared twice along a chain
a default has its parameter's type
a required parameter has no default
a bool is not a path type
a legacy entry names a destination
a legacy template names a source parameter

returnTo.name: the sign-in route is never a target
the not-found route is never a target
resume without a target goes home
resume refuses an encoded double slash
the sign-in location carries the target
the sign-in location without a target

locations.name: hash: the fragment is the location
hash: no fragment is the root
hash: an empty fragment is the root
hash: an anchor is a location
path: an href is the location
hash: a shared link keeps the document path and query

inventory.name: the views table in hash mode
